title: Electoral College On Life Support

author: LegalEagle
description:
AI scored in the 90th percentile on the bar exam. That still doesn’t mean it should be writing your motions 🤖

The appeal is easy to understand. Most people can’t afford an experienced attorney billing a few hundred dollars an hour, and legal research platforms like Westlaw and Lexis cost thousands a year. In theory, AI-assisted representation could put legal help within reach of people who currently go without it.

A 2023 study makes the case look even stronger. ChatGPT-4 beat the average human test taker by more than 7%, scoring high enough for admission to practice in most states.

The problem is what a test score can’t tell you. Passing the bar doesn’t make anyone a strong litigator, and letting an AI draft your motion without oversight puts your case in the hands of the equivalent of an unsupervised intern.

Would you let AI draft a motion in your own case?

#AILawyer #ArtificialIntelligence #BarExam
title: Should You Ask AI For Legal Advice?
